statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = true if and only if s is a valid bracket sequence, meaning s belongs to the language generated by V ::= ε | V V | '(' V ')' | '[' V ']' | '{' V '}'; equivalently, the bracket occurrences in s can be paired so that each pair consists of an opening bracket followed later by its matching closing bracket of the same type, every occurrence belongs to exactly one pair, and no two pairs cross. In particular, r = false exactly when s is not such a valid sequence.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), the byte s[i] is one of 40, 41, 91, 93, 123, 125 (that is, one of the ASCII characters '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}').

statement: The function returns a result r for every s satisfying the preconditions; it does not fail, panic, overflow, or access out of bounds.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), the byte s[i] is one of 40, 41, 91, 93, 123, 125.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if len(s) is odd, then r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and every byte of s is one of '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}'.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true, then s[0] is an opening bracket (byte 40 '(', 91 '[', or 123 '{') and s[len(s)-1] is a closing bracket (byte 41 ')', 93 ']', or 125 '}').
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and every byte of s is one of '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}'.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true, then for every k with 0 <= k <= len(s), among the prefix bytes s[0], ..., s[k-1], the number of opening brackets is at least the number of closing brackets. Here opening brackets are '(', '[', '{' and closing brackets are ')', ']', '}'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and every byte of s is one of '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}'.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true, then the number of occurrences of '(' in s equals the number of occurrences of ')', the number of occurrences of '[' equals the number of occurrences of ']', and the number of occurrences of '{' equals the number of occurrences of '}'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and every byte of s is one of '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}'.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true, then for every index i with 0 <= i < len(s) such that s[i] is a closing bracket, let o be the opening bracket of the corresponding type (')' corresponds to '(', ']' corresponds to '[', '}' corresponds to '{'); in the prefix s[0], ..., s[i-1], the number of occurrences of o is strictly greater than the number of occurrences of s[i].
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and every byte of s is one of '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}'.

statement: For every s satisfying the preconditions, let t be the byte array of the same length defined by t[i] = complement(s[len(s)-1-i]) for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), where complement maps '(' to ')', ')' to '(', '[' to ']', ']' to '[', '{' to '}', and '}' to '{'. Then whenever the function returns a result r on s and a result r' on t, r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and every byte of s is one of '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}'.

statement: Let s and t be nonempty byte arrays consisting only of allowed bracket bytes with len(s) + len(t) <= 10000. If s and t are both valid bracket sequences (each belongs to the language generated by V ::= ε | V V | '(' V ')' | '[' V ']' | '{' V '}'), then whenever the function returns a result r on the concatenation s ++ t (the byte array of length len(s)+len(t) whose first len(s) bytes are s and whose remaining bytes are t), r = true.
preconditions: The function is evaluated on the concatenation s ++ t, where s and t are nonempty byte arrays consisting only of allowed bracket bytes and len(s) + len(t) <= 10000.

statement: If there exist a valid bracket sequence t (possibly empty) and a matching opening-closing pair (a, b) equal to ('(', ')') or ('[', ']') or ('{', '}') such that s is the concatenation a ++ t ++ b, then whenever the function returns a result r on s, r = true.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and every byte of s is one of '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}'.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if every byte of s is an opening bracket (that is, each s[i] is one of '(', '[', '{'), then r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and every byte of s is one of '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}'.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if every byte of s is a closing bracket (that is, each s[i] is one of ')', ']', '}'), then r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 10000, and every byte of s is one of '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}'.
